description: Emulation of the Spin Semiconductor FV-1 reverb and effects chip, running an assembler program loaded from a .spn file, with the chip's three control pots brought out as knobs

The right channel, the trimmed right input and the program's right output mixed by DRY/WET, clipped to ±10V

notes: Clicking the display with either mouse button opens its own menu, which is where the FX bank is loaded and where the bank's programs are listed by category.
The module comes up with demo.spn, the one program shipped with the plugin, so the arrow buttons do nothing until another .spn file or an FX bank is loaded.
A bank of 157 programs is published as programs.json in the maker's repository; it is not part of the plugin and has to be fetched and loaded.
All four attenuverters are at their centre when the module is added, so none of the four CV jacks does anything until one is turned.
Each jack carries one channel, so a polyphonic cable is reduced to its first channel.
The back arrow cannot reach the first program of a bank: stepping back from the second jumps to the last instead.
menu: Select SPN File... — opens a file chooser for one FV-1 assembler program, and the arrow buttons then step through the other .spn files in that same folder
Parser log... — writes what the assembler made of the loaded program into a file beside the plugin and opens it
Select FX-Bank... — on the display's own menu rather than the panel's: opens a file chooser for a programs.json holding many programs at once
